title.narrative: Documentation of CAFOD East Africa programme impact

description.narrative: Transformational Dawn is CAFOD East Africa’s Regional Strategy Paper (RSP) for the period 2013 – 2018. The paper strongly points out that in order to achieve the set blueprint, we will address four key perspectives which are: Achievements, Excelling, Strategic investments and Resourcing. The strategy is in line with the corporate strategy; Just One World; as it recognizes the four aims of J1W. However, the EA strategy cannot be fully realised if the existing short comings within our programmes have not been addressed. CAFOD East Africa programming has inadequate documentation on programme successes and impacts, best practices and lessons learned from communities and with partners we work with. Links between all these with future programming and strategies have also not been documentated. The reports we currently have are more of projects implementation progressive reports which only capture the information required by donors but they do not show the impacts or lessons learnt especially for CAFOD. The current reporting trends are continuously demanding of the Programme Officers and partners to report against their outcome indicators, the realized impacts and demonstrate the value for money. The Programme team together with the partners need to identify and document the difference their efforts (and funds) have made to the poorest and most vulnerable communities; as well as demonstrate that these efforts are effective in bringing about change. Further, the programme team and partners should understand the implications of their work, be accountable to the beneficiaries, and constantly strive to achieve better outcomes. These have resulted in the production of M&E tools and frameworks to assess programme impact.
